name: Exact Visibility Ordering for Cell Projection Volume Rendering (SXMPVO)
aliases: Exact Visibility Ordering for Cell Projection Volume Rendering
SXMPVO (Scanning Exact Meshed Polyhedra Visibility Ordering)
Scanning Exact Meshed Polyhedra Visibility Ordering
definition: SXMPVO is an algorithm that finds a global ordering of cells in an unstructured mesh to produce correct segment sorting along viewing rays for volume rendering. It handles nonconvex boundaries and disconnected components, provided the mesh is acyclic. It uses image-precision ray shooting via scan conversion rather than object-precision queries.
summary: SXMPVO computes image-precision visibility ordering for volume rendering by replacing expensive ray shooting with efficient scan conversion to determine occlusion relations.
